title: tetraclinis articulata
intro: Tetraclinis articulata, commonly known as the Atlas Cedar, is a coniferous tree native to the Mediterranean region. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in the treatment of skin conditions, wounds, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Tetraclinis articulata include its ability to reduce inflammation, fight off infections, and exhibit antioxidant and immunomodulatory activities. The bioactive constituents responsible for these actions include essential oils, terpenoids, and phenolic compounds, which have been identified as α-pinene, β-pinene, and limonene among others.
